scim.base_url: (SCIM base URL shown in Devin settings, ends in /scim/v2)

auth.token_source: Settings > Enterprise > Membership > Members > User and IdP group provisioning > Generate token

deprovision.notes: Deactivation removes the user's enterprise membership immediately; reassigning restores it. On legacy Windsurf Enterprise, removing a user disables access and stops the user taking up a seat (k4).

custom.how: Other attributes are ignored (legacy Windsurf Enterprise SCIM accepts custom cliActive and acuCycleLimit attributes).

roles.how: SCIM users get the default Enterprise Member role; SCIM groups appear as IdP groups mapped to enterprise roles and orgs in Settings > Enterprise > Membership > Groups (IdP).

limitations.text: Only a limited attribute set is supported; other attributes are ignored. userName must be the user's work email.
Login-based JIT provisioning should be turned off when SCIM is used, or groups re-sync on every login.
No Okta or Entra catalogue app: Okta uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token) and Entra a non-gallery app.

scim.notes: Legacy Windsurf Enterprise (Devin Desktop) teams use https://server.codeium.com/scim/v2 with a service-key Bearer token; that page says it does not apply to Cognition Platform plans.

auth.notes: Service-user or personal access token (cog_ prefix) as a Bearer token; endpoints are gated by RBAC permissions.

endpoints.purpose: List users with direct role assignments
Invite users (bulk) with an enterprise role
List IdP groups and their role mappings

limitations.text: Users whose membership comes from IdP groups cannot be removed or edited through the user endpoints; manage them through IdP groups.

user_api.notes: Member management sits under /v3/enterprise/* (Enterprise). An organization-level Users & Membership API is in beta and read-only.

okta.notes: No Okta catalogue app found; Devin documents the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token) plus a separate OIDC/SAML app for SSO.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery app found; Devin documents a non-gallery app.

row.evidence: Devin's pricing page lists SAML/OIDC SSO only under the "Let's talk" Enterprise plan, and its SCIM docs say "Devin Enterprise supports SCIM 2.0 for automatic user and group provisioning."
row.notes: Windsurf (formerly Codeium) is now sold as part of Devin by Cognition: windsurf.com/pricing redirects to devin.ai/pricing and the Windsurf editor is now Devin Desktop. Plans changed since June: the Teams plan is now $80/month for the team plus $40/month per full seat (free flex seats; $80/month minimum; monthly price, no annual option shown; up to 200 users), replacing Teams at $35/user; the $60/user Enterprise price is gone and Enterprise is now Contact Sales. SSO and SCIM are Enterprise-only. Research covers Devin Enterprise (Cognition Platform) SCIM; legacy Windsurf Enterprise teams use a separate SCIM endpoint at https://server.codeium.com/scim/v2 (Enterprise-only), where removing a user frees the seat.
